This repository contains the supplementary data and underlying models for the thesis titled: "The role of Circular Economy in Resource Security: A Material and Economic Analysis of Titanium Supply in the European Union." As Titanium is classified as a Critical Raw Material (CRM) by the European Commission, this research evaluates the potential of Circular Economy (CE) strategies to mitigate supply chain vulnerabilities.
